headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal still keen on Real Madrid winger Rodrygo
description: Arsenal remain in contact with the camp of Real Madrid winger Rodrygo as a potential long-term target Transfer talk has the latest.

headline: Man United will be 'careful' with Gabriel future, Carrick says
description: Michael Carrick confirmed he is involved in conversations about JJ Gabriel's future after the 15-year-old's request to leave Manchester United made major ripples and that the team is being "careful" with the situation.

headline: Man United's collapse puts Carrick under pressure for first time
description: After being eliminated by Brighton & Hove Albion in the Carabao Cup, Manchester United boss Michael Carrick is now facing the first real pressure of his reign.

headline: Boehly, Walter sell Chelsea stakes as Clearlake takes full control
description: Clearlake Capital has taken full control of Chelsea after acquiring the ownership stakes of Mark Walter and Todd Boehly, the Premier League club announced Wednesday.

headline: Michael Carrick: 'We can't accept' Man United showing in Carabao Cup exit, 'I take responsibility'
description: Michael Carrick branded Manchester United's capitulation as unacceptable, after watching his team lose 3-2 to Brighton in the Carabao Cup after leading 2-0.

headline: Chelsea's João Pedro withdraws from Brazil squad with injury
description: Chelsea striker João Pedro has withdrawn from the Brazil squad because of injury.
